sourceFirstRuling.lexicalAdmission: PASS removal: 囑令加護 is transparent compositional narration—'instructed/charged [someone] to protect or sustain [it]'—whose person and object come from each anecdote. The four graphs acquire no distinct Zen technical action, image, verdict, or contrast.
sourceFirstRuling.currentGlossDiagnosis: PASS: 'charge him to guard it carefully' necessarily supplies an unstated pronoun and object from one story, demonstrating sentence translation rather than autonomous dictionary semantics.
sourceFirstRuling.completeCaseCoverage: PASS: all seven extracted cases were classified. They reduce to the Huanglong–Lü Yan anecdote, the Yuanwu–Zhao Lingjin anecdote, and one lay-authored preface.
sourceFirstRuling.familyCollapse: PASS: seven files are only three narrative families. The Huanglong story appears in two Tier-2 active raisings plus one lamp; the Yuanwu story appears in one Tier-2 active raising plus two lamps; the lay preface is independent prose but not Zen-master lexical evidence.
sourceFirstRuling.lampContamination: PASS: T/T51/T51n2077.xml, X/X79/X79n1559.xml, and X/X80/X80n1565.xml are Tier-3 parallel narrations and correctly contribute zero retained depth. The installed entry's X79 witness is genuine lamp contamination.
sourceFirstRuling.narratorOwnership: PASS: 悟見，囑令加護 in X/X79/X79n1559.xml is third-person narrative and was wrongly stored as Yuanwu Keqin's utterance. Where Xueguan Zhiyin, Shuijian Hai, and Chuiwan Guangzhen themselves repeat the clause while raising a case, they own that repeated wording, but active quotation/commentary does not make its transparent internal narrative clause a lexicalized term.
sourceFirstRuling.sourceHierarchy: PASS: no Tier-1 evidence; four Tier-2 containers include two repeated case families and one lay preface; three Tier-3 lamps add no independent meaning.
sourceFirstRuling.repairAction: PASS: remove the dictionary article atomically. Do not preserve it by padding repeated anecdotes, and do not transfer the current pronoun-bearing English gloss to 加護.
